LK-HERO-SUB: A brand, a site and a 30 to 60 day sprint, built to look right and get moving.
LK-WHO-H2: Who the Launch Kit is for
LK-WHO-BODY: New or relaunching brands that need to look right and get moving. Think a UK skincare brand that's genuinely good but looks like everyone else's, a studio about to open its doors or a founder who has outgrown the logo they made at the kitchen table. Same story in Australia, Canada and Singapore.
LK-INC-A: The Launch Kit gives a new or relaunching brand three things in one plan: a brand identity, a website or landing page and a 30 to 60 day performance or social sprint. Everything runs on the same brand codes, so your launch looks like one brand from the first post to the first ad.
LK-INC-1-BODY: Logo, colour, type and the rules that hold it together, built around distinctive codes people remember.
LK-INC-2-BODY: A site or landing page that says what you do in plain words and gives every visitor a clear next step.
LK-INC-3-BODY: A focused performance or social sprint that puts your new codes in front of the right people, straight after the brand and site go live.
LK-HOW-1-BODY: We look at your brand, your market and where you're found or missed: in search, on social and in AI answers.
LK-HOW-2-BODY: A sharp position and a short list of distinctive brand codes. Everything we build after this answers to it.
LK-HOW-3-BODY: Identity, site, content and campaigns made together, so every touchpoint looks and sounds like you.
LK-HOW-4-BODY: We measure what's working, report it plainly and refine, so every campaign gives the next one a head start.
LK-PKG-H2: What should a branding package include?
LK-PKG-A: More than a logo. A useful branding package covers clear positioning and a short set of distinctive brand codes such as colours, shapes and words. It should come with guidelines your team can actually use. The Launch Kit then puts those codes to work on a website or landing page and a focused sprint.
LK-LAUNCH-H2: How do you launch a new brand identity?
LK-LAUNCH-A: Decide what people should remember about you first, then build the identity around it. Launch it everywhere at once, on your site, socials and ads, so customers meet the same codes again and again. Plan your first sprint of activity before you go live, not after the launch post.
LK-SKIN-H2: Launching a skincare brand? Start here
LK-SKIN-A: Distinctiveness first. Skincare is crowded and plenty of new brands look alike, so start with a clear position and brand codes people recognise without reading the label. Next comes a site that explains the product plainly. Then run a focused sprint on the channel where your buyers already are, paid social or organic social.
LK-ALT-BODY: Only need one piece? Take Branding, Performance marketing or Social media on its own. The kit makes sense when you need all three at once, built on the same brand codes. Already launched and need to be found? The Authority Kit is your next step.
LK-FAQ-1-A: Three things in one plan: a brand identity, a website or landing page and a 30 to 60 day performance or social sprint. They're built together on the same brand codes, so your launch looks and sounds like one brand everywhere people meet it. The fit call is where we shape the plan.
LK-FAQ-2-Q: Is the sprint performance marketing, social media or both?
LK-FAQ-2-A: It can be performance, social or a mix of the two. We agree the split with you at kickoff, based on where your buyers already spend their time. A skincare brand might lean on paid social, while a studio might start with organic posts. Either way, it runs on your new brand codes.
LK-FAQ-3-Q: Is 30 to 60 days how long the whole kit takes?
LK-FAQ-3-A: No. The 30 to 60 days describes the performance or social sprint only, not the time it takes to build your brand identity and your site. We agree the plan for the full kit with you at kickoff, once we know your scope and who signs off.
LK-FAQ-4-Q: How much does the Launch Kit cost?
LK-FAQ-4-A: It depends on what you need, so there's no price list here. We scope every project after a short, no-pressure fit call, once we know your goals, your channels and where your brand feels stuck. You get a clear proposal before any work starts.
LK-FAQ-5-Q: Can I take just the branding?
LK-FAQ-5-A: Yes. Take any service on its own or combine them in a kit. Branding works on its own if you mainly need a sharper identity. It's also the base of the Launch Kit, for when you need a site and a sprint too. The fit call is where we work out what comes first.
LK-FAQ-6-Q: Do you work with brands outside the UK?
LK-FAQ-6-A: Yes. We work with SMB founders and marketing leads across the UK, Australia, Canada and Singapore, remotely, with calls planned around your time zone. A launch in Australia or Singapore gets the same care as one in the UK, and we check your codes make sense in every market you sell in.
